name: AtlasFetch
description:
Send a coordinate; get back the country, region and municipality that contain it,
plus matches from your own uploaded boundary sets — in one call. Optionally, the
nearest street and house number, worldwide (per-country detail at /streets/coverage).

**When to use it:** reverse geocoding to administrative areas, geofencing against your
own polygons, jurisdiction and region checks, enriching location data with region codes.

**When not to:** forward geocoding (address to coordinate) or place search, a
guaranteed house number (OpenStreetMap maps them unevenly), routing or map tiles,
retrieving boundary or street geometry, many coordinates in one request, or
enter/exit event tracking.

A fuller reference for automated clients is at https://atlasfetch.xyz/llms.txt

Reference boundaries and streets derive from OpenStreetMap under the ODbL; attribution and
share-alike obligations pass through to you. Looked-up coordinates are not stored.
